children: Airbus delivered fewer planes than expected in October and needs to step up its game to achieve its annual guidance, according to Jefferies. "Airbus now needs 20% growth on deliveries through year-end to reach its 870 delivery guide, which should be partly helped by higher-than-usual inventory levels at 72 flying aircraft," Jefferies analysts say in a research note. In October, the European plane maker delivered 74 aircraft, 5% fewer than in the same month last year and 3 below what Jefferies expected. Shares fall 0.4%. (adria.calatayud@wsj.com)
